text: Grok Build Mode — new feature by SpaceXAI for Grok 4.5. Full app builder inside chat: describe what you want, it builds, previews, and iterates. Websites, dashboards, games, 3D worlds, calculators. No IDE/terminal/laptop needed. Publish via grok.me or custom domain. Available on iOS/Android. Early Beta for SuperGrok Heavy users. Source: @DevTwitter
